The '''Charis system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="DarkStryder note">Page 5 of ''The DarkStryder Campaign''{{'s}} Adventure Book states that star systems and primary worlds in the Kathol sector share the same name unless otherwise noted.</ref> The system contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Charis]], and was situated on the [[Trition Trade Route]]. The system was connected to the [[Aaris system/Legends|Aaris]], [[Kolatill system/Legends|Kolatill]], [[Corjain system/Legends|Corjain]], [[Mairne system/Legends|Mairne]] and [[Ott system]]s via [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]].<ref name="tdc" />
